checks.observer_updates: The new-cartridge default-cache walkthrough passed before the eviction-aware observer update. Its source hash is retained separately; the standard-capacity miss-free assertion is unchanged. The two manual routes use the updated observer. Patched-XLOS startup checks use no command walkthrough.

limitations: Development checks only; no full qualification matrix or physical cartridge/hardware claim.
Supported firmware remains the pinned AltirraOS 65816 ROM. Patched XLOS overrides cover only stated startup/EXIT scope.
No remote kernel loader or upstream Open Firmware layer added.
BYE/busy/init-failure park; reset/reload required. Exec exit does not resume the retired interpreter.
OF816 assembly embeds the upstream build-time word; rebuilding the monitor can change its XEX hash while reusing identical native output.
